title: Top 1% of Polymarket accounts took 91% of U.S. midterm winnings, study finds
summary: The top 1% of Polymarket traders scooped up 91% of the winnings from U.S. midterm bets, suggesting the platform's wealth is consolidating around a tiny cluster of sophisticated players.
